OSMetaClass::instanceConstructed: exact 32-byte current body increments class instance counts and walks superclass pointers; it does not operate on provider ownership or firmware.

IOLog diagnostic output is not an AFK/DP command and receives formatted diagnostics, not the fresh client as an ownership callback. Logging completion is not used as hardware-safety evidence.

IORegistryEntry::attachToParent: pinned implementation updates service-plane links and immutable collection flags. Both concrete DPDV/client and provider attachment slots bind to IORegistryEntry; parent attachToChild is not IOService::open. This annotation does not classify arbitrary descendants.

IORegistryEntry::attachToChild is the selected DCPDP provider slot 904. It creates reciprocal registry links; the already linked child prevents recursive new attachment. No owner+64 assignment, provider open, or dispatch-table call.

IORegistryEntry::detachFromParent removes reciprocal service-plane links. Provider detachFromChild is inherited registry code. Retain/release ownership here is distinct from provider.open; final dynamic object destruction is not waived by this function-local annotation.

Concrete client IOService::attach uses provider arbitration, service-plane attachment and cached provider lookup; child-count pressure has a single 15-second local detach deadline. The resolved attachToParent/attachToChild slots do not establish provider ownership. Descendants remain independently classified.

Conditional provider.close slot 1544 reaches DCPAVProxy::close. Its callback sends at 0xfffffe000a009c2c. Receipt preserves the condition and does not assert that zero-selector close takes it.

This separately rooted case is the zero-initialized, never-run DPDV gate. Only runAction sets wait-enable bit1/action count at +72; no selectors/runAction/runCommand means both remain zero. Removal sets bit0, skips bit1 sleep and clears the workloop. Shared-lock acquisition is analyzed separately; no active-selector root inherits this condition.
